metadata.scenario: A prospect is interested in learning more about the clinic's approach to sports injury rehabilitation. Category: New Inquiry. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, my name is Robert Jackson. I’m looking to learn more about your approach to sports injury rehabilitation. Hi Robert! I appreciate your interest. We primarily focus on personalized rehabilitation plans tailored to each individual. That’s good to hear. Do you have physical therapists who specialize in this area? Yes, we do. Dr. James Rodriguez is our physical therapist, and he specializes in post-surgery rehabilitation and mobility training. Great! Can you tell me how the rehabilitation sessions are structured? Each session typically lasts between 45 to 60 minutes, focusing on exercises to improve strength, mobility, and balance tailored to the specific injury. That sounds suitable. How much do these sessions cost? The price for physical therapy is between $110 and $140 per session, depending on the complexity of the rehabilitation required. Okay, that’s reasonable. Do you also provide follow-up assessments? Yes, we offer ongoing assessments to monitor progress and adjust treatment plans as necessary. Good to know. What’s the process to get started? You would need to schedule an initial evaluation with Dr. Rodriguez. He’ll assess the injury and create a personalized plan for you. How long does the evaluation take and what’s the cost? The evaluation typically lasts about an hour, and it costs $100. That includes a comprehensive assessment and treatment recommendations. Sounds like it’s worth it. Can I schedule that evaluation now? Absolutely! I can help you with that. What day are you looking to come in? I’m available this Thursday. Let me check Dr. Rodriguez’s schedule. One moment please. Sure, take your time. Okay, he has an opening at 10 AM this Thursday. Does that work for you? Yes, that works perfectly! Great! I’ll book you in for Thursday at 10 AM for the evaluation. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help. You’re welcome, Robert! Before we hang up, do you have any other questions? Not at the moment. I’ll see you Thursday! Looking forward to it! Have a great day! You too, bye! Goodbye!
